Global stocks slump in an AI sell-off, and Putin vows a 'painful' response to Ukraine's strikes on the Kerch bridge.
text.international: Cop31 talks enter their final day, with African negotiators saying rich countries undermine the summit's credibility as the summit heads for a late finish. Downing Street says the EU-UK reset deal is done though some talks continue, and the US reacts cautiously to the ICJ's Myanmar genocide ruling while the EU praises the court. Protests follow an Iraqi university's removal of male professors teaching women, and global stocks slump in an AI sell-off.
